visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing black-rimmed glasses and a cream-colored zip-up jacket stands outdoors in front of a glass-fronted Olive Young store. He speaks with high energy, pointing his finger toward the camera and gesturing downward. Pedestrians and a red-clothed person pass by in the background under bright daylight. (2) Inside a brightly lit retail environment, the man interviews a young male wearing a tan baseball cap and a dark bomber jacket. They are surrounded by shelves of skincare products and promotional posters. The interviewee holds a small cardboard box and gestures toward display counters while looking slightly exhausted. (3) The scene shifts back outdoors to a different young man wearing a black hoodie and backpack, sitting on a stone bench in front of the store. He looks at his phone and then looks up at the interviewer with a humorous expression of resignation. (4) Inside the store again, a man with thick eyebrows and a black shirt is interviewed. He holds a large bag of snack food with a picture of fries on it. He smiles and shows the product to the camera while shoppers move in the background. (5) Back outside, the man in the tan cap shows a map on his smartphone screen, which displays numerous Olive Young locations in the Hongdae area of Seoul. A shot of a green Innisfree storefront is shown briefly before returning to the man and the interviewer laughing together.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately over an upbeat, 128 BPM electronic comedy track. The voice is bright and projected, using a fast speech rate to set a humorous tone. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals the start of the interview series. (2) The audio shifts to a dialogue interplay between the host and the first interviewee. The background music continues at a consistent volume. The interviewee's voice is slightly lower in arousal, sounding tired but cooperative, punctuated by a comical 'ding' sound effect. (3) A digital transition SFX leads into the second interview. This voice has a higher pitch variability, sounding jokingly argumentative. A cartoonish sliding sound effect accompanies a punchline about waiting for hours. (4) The third interview features a warm, friendly vocal tone from the interviewee, accompanied by a laugh track SFX and the rustling of a snack bag. The BGM maintains a steady, lighthearted rhythmic bed throughout the interaction. (5) The final phase features synchronized laughter from multiple male voices. The master track is bright with a high spectral centroid, emphasizing the energetic and sociable atmosphere of the street interview production.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of Interviews -> Conclusion/Humorous Observation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous street interview intended to entertain viewers by highlighting the common 'struggle' of boyfriends waiting for their girlfriends to shop at the ubiquitous Olive Young skincare stores in South Korea. It uses a relatable social observation to engage a young adult audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is filmed almost entirely in front of or inside Olive Young, mentions the brand name multiple times, and features specific products prominently.
